questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which of the following is true about ice worms?
A. They live in ice
B. They are active during the day
C. They can make ice
Answer: A. Resembling tiny earthworms, ice worms produce antifreeze proteins that prevent their cells from freezing. They are more active at night but retreat into glacier ice during warmer parts of the day, as they begin to die at temperatures as “hot” as 41 °F (5 °C).
questions.de: Worin verbringen Gletschereiswürmer, winzige Ringelwürmer, die schon bei etwa 5 °C zu sterben beginnen, ihr ganzes Leben?
questions.en: In what do glacier ice worms, tiny annelids that start to die at about 5 °C, spend their entire lives?

timeline.labelEn: Gustav Eisen names the ice worm genus Mesenchytraeus
timeline.labelDe: Gustav Eisen benennt die Eiswurm-Gattung Mesenchytraeus

questions.notes: Confirmed: the best-known ice worms are the only annelids known to spend their entire lives in glacial ice; they retreat under the ice before dawn and fall apart at about 5 °C. Note: most species of the genus actually live in riverine gravel beds, not ice.

questions.cardText:
[History] Which country was formerly known as Siam?
A. Vietnam B. Thailand C. Cambodia
Answer: B. Thailand is also known to celebrate its New Year (Songkran) in April with a nationwide water fight, which is believed to wash away bad luck.
questions.en: Which country was known as Siam until 1939?

timeline.labelDe: Siam wird offiziell in Thailand umbenannt

questions.notes: Confirmed: officially renamed Thailand on 24 June 1939 (briefly Siam again 1945–1948).
